purpose: Complete the D06 learning-room semantic remediation for flow/ownership intent overclaim and passive-active double counting by freezing one-primitive/one-receipt-many-consumers lineage rules.

rootCause.risk: Observed institutional flow, ownership, passive-event, leverage, crowding, lending, broker and retail-proxy data can be renamed as intent or counted repeatedly across D06 modules.
failureModes: observed flow -> active conviction without identification
index event -> passive flow -> ETF mechanics counted as separate votes despite shared origin
TDCC ownership -> ownership concentration -> crowding counted as multiple independent votes
borrowing/SBL -> borrow economics -> ETF fulfillment or short pressure counted independently without lineage
same primitive reused across System1/System2 scoring layers without effectiveIndependentEvidenceCount

primitiveFamilies.antiDoubleCount: Crowding or normalized-flow children may transform this primitive but do not create a second independent directional vote by name alone.
D06-05/D06-06 consume the same TDCC receipt; one weekly ownership vintage cannot become two independent ownership votes.
Event expectation is one event primitive. Realized passive flow is independent only when directly measured from a separate fund-flow receipt rather than imputed from the event.
D06-16 mechanics explains transmission/friction and cannot re-count the same units delta as another vote.
Margin activity is leverage evidence, not direct-retail identity; D06-19 may benchmark proxy purity/coverage but not create a second retail-flow primitive.
Borrow activity, lending economics and ETF fulfillment must share linked primitive IDs; generic borrowing is not a second short-sale vote.
Fee/scarcity is an economic state derived from lending markets; downstream feasibility/context consumers must not convert it into extra bearish votes.
High day-trading activity is not direct-retail flow and not a separate crowding vote unless residual incrementality is proven.
Public-bank or main-force labels are metadata/context on the same execution receipt unless independent beneficial-owner evidence exists.
D20 may add behavior-specific evidence but cannot re-score the same direct-retail primitive as an independent behavioral vote without an extra identifiable observable.

interpretationLayers.rule: Direct source observation only. Identity/motive labels are limited to what the source explicitly identifies.
A deterministic or rule-based transform references parentReceiptIds and inherits the same information root; transformation alone does not create independent evidence.
Index/passive, ETF-mechanics, policy-proxy, retail-proxy and lending-mechanism states may change interpretation/confidence but do not create extra direction by default.
May be treated as distinct only after D16 common-support/residual/OOS tests prove information beyond its parents and redundancy group.

sharedReceiptRules: Each source observation receives one primitiveReceiptId.
Every derived child stores parentReceiptIds, informationRoot, sourceVintage/firstKnownAt and transformationVersion.
Multiple modules may consume one receipt but must expose dependency rather than independentVote=true.
A child derived only from existing parents has effectiveIndependentEvidenceCount=0 until residual incrementality is proven.
A directly measured new source family may add one candidate independent evidence unit, subject to common-support and redundancy tests.
UNKNOWN source/motive/coverage remains UNKNOWN and is never converted to zero/no-event/no-flow.
Later revisions append new vintages; they never overwrite the historical decision-time receipt.
Repeated symbols on one market date do not manufacture independent market-regime evidence; repeated scan dates on one TDCC vintage do not manufacture ownership updates.

passiveActiveResidualTestPrerequisites.testQuestion: Does directly measured realized passive/fund flow add information beyond event expectation and ordinary institutional flow, or does the institutional feature retain residual value after passive context is controlled?
passiveActiveResidualTestPrerequisites.outcomeGate: CLOSED until prospective PIT coverage and D16 preregistration are satisfied
passiveActiveResidualTestPrerequisites.noEventRule: No event row means NO_EVENT only when declared event-universe coverage is complete; otherwise UNKNOWN.
